title: Tomboy has to go from Bully to Girlfriend (ORIGINAL)
description: Sorry for punching you. And those things I said about your dick, or how you liked to stick it in other guys. You really should have fought me like I wanted. I really wasn't expecting them to be so strict here at this school. They have some bullshit zero-tolerance policy. Now they want to expel me. But if you stick up for me at that school hearing tomorrow, they can't expel me. At least it will work in my favor. Now, you don't have any real reason to go out on a limb for me. I'm just a tough girl who only made it into this private school out of charity and a quota. But I think I have an idea about how I can make you want to help me out...
author: Mistress Shibby
